other_conditions: Applicant must be a leather artisan.

Applicant must belong to listed sub‑castes among Scheduled Castes (Arundathiyar, Chammadiya, Chamar, Chambar, Chamagar, Madar, Madig, Madiga, Mini Madig, Jambavalu, Haralayya, Machigar, Mochigar, Mochi, muchi, Telugu Mochi, kamaati mocha, Rohidas, Dhor, kakkayya, Kankayya, Samagara, Samagar, Aadhi Anddra, Aadhi Dravida, Aadhi Karnataka).
Applicant's annual family income must not exceed ₹30,000 in rural areas or ₹25,000 in urban areas.
Applicant or family members must not have received benefits from other schemes, except training programs.
Family members must not be employed in government or semi‑government organizations.
benefits_summary: Provides a subsidy ranging from ₹2 lakh to ₹5 lakh for setting up a showroom or mobile van, with the amount varying by location.
